import random
MASK=0xFFFFFFFF
def rotl2(t): return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xFF
def g(a,b,x): return rotl2((a+b+x)&0xFF)
def F(v):
    x=[(v>>(8*i))&0xFF for i in range(4)]; y=[0]*4
    y[2]=g(x[3]^x[2],x[1]^x[0],1)
    y[3]=g(x[3],y[2],0)
    y[1]=g(x[1]^x[0],y[2],0)
    y[0]=g(x[0],y[1],1)
    return sum(y[i]<<(8*i) for i in range(4))
def Finv(v):
    a=[(v>>(8*i))&0xFF for i in range(4)]
    R=lambda y:((y>>2)|(y<<6))&0xFF
    x0=(R(a[0])-a[1]-1)&0xFF
    p=(R(a[1])-a[2])&0xFF
    x3=(R(a[3])-a[2])&0xFF
    q=(R(a[2])-p-1)&0xFF
    x2=x3^q; x1=p^x0
    return x0|(x1<<8)|(x2<<16)|(x3<<24)
# test inverse
for _ in range(10000):
    v=random.getrandbits(32)
    assert Finv(F(v))==v and F(Finv(v))==v, (hex(v),hex(F(v)))
print("F/Finv ok")
def expand(k): return (k ^ ((k<<16)&MASK) ^ ((k*12345)&MASK))&MASK
def set_keys(ks): return [expand(k&0xFFFFF) for k in ks]
def encrypt(pt,keys):
    L=(pt>>32)&MASK; R=pt&MASK
    R^=L
    for r in range(4):
        m=F(R^keys[r]); L,R=R,L^m
    L^=R
    return ((R&MASK)<<32)|(L&MASK)
def decrypt(ct,keys):
    L=ct&MASK; R=(ct>>32)&MASK  # per decrypt.c: left=getright, right=getleft
    L^=R
    for r in range(3,-1,-1):
        temp=L; L=R; m=F(temp^keys[r]); R=temp; L^=m
    R^=L
    return ((L&MASK)<<32)|(R&MASK)

seeds=[random.randrange(1<<20) for _ in range(4)]
keys=set_keys(seeds)
print("seeds",[hex(s) for s in seeds],"keys",[hex(k) for k in keys])
# generate pairs
pairs=[]
for _ in range(32):
    pt=random.getrandbits(64)
    ct=encrypt(pt,keys)
    pairs.append((pt,ct))
# check decryption matches encrypt
assert all(decrypt(c,keys)==p for p,c in pairs)
# check attack algebra
def derive_Cs(c):
    return (c&0xFFFFFFFF)^((c>>32)&0xFFFFFFFF), (c>>32)&0xFFFFFFFF
K0,K1,K2,K3=keys
phis=[]; psis=[]
for (p,c) in pairs:
    Lp=(p>>32)&MASK; Rp=p&MASK
    R3,R4=derive_Cs(c)
    # forward true R1
    R1 = Lp ^ F(Rp ^ K0)
    phi = Lp ^ F(Rp ^ K0)
    # backward
    R2 = R4 ^ F(R3 ^ K3)
    psi = Finv(R2 ^ Rp)
    phis.append(phi); psis.append(psi)
    assert (phi^psi)==K1, (hex(phi^psi),hex(K1))
# signature equality
sigL=tuple(phis[i]^phis[0] for i in (1,2,3))
sigR=tuple(psis[i]^psis[0] for i in (1,2,3))
print("sig equal:",sigL==sigR)
# derive K2
for i,(p,c) in enumerate(pairs):
    Lp=(p>>32)&MASK; Rp=p&MASK
    R3,R4=derive_Cs(c)
    R2 = R4 ^ F(R3^K3)
    R1 = phis[i]
    k2 = R2 ^ Finv(R1 ^ R3)
    assert k2==K2, (i,hex(k2),hex(K2))
print("K2 derivation ok")
# injectivity of expand
seen={}
for s in range(1<<20):
    k=expand(s)
    if k in seen:
        print("COLLISION",s,seen[k],hex(k)); break
    seen[k]=s
else:
    print("expand injective on 20 bits, distinct",len(seen))
